slots.topic: 地毯踩久那股味，捲起來前先看底面有沒有潮
slots.instagram_caption:
地毯踩久那股味，捲起來前先看底面有沒有潮。

我們收件會先把地毯捲起來看底面，潮氣通常從膠底和牆邊先發。表面乾、底面涼或發黑，那股味多半不是踩髒，是濕氣悶在夾層。自己灑除臭噴霧再捲回去，味道會更重。

底面已經發霉或膠層脫了，洗完也只能壓味道，回不到新地毯。台中市區我們免費到府收送，你先拍底面和整張給我們看。

slots.image_prompt: OBJECT PASSPORT: exactly one rolled-back rug showing its backing (object locked as one rolled-back rug showing its backing; every surface is blank: no printed, embossed, woven or stitched marks, letters, labels or emblems of any size); color/material: used woven rug with a fabric face and a rubberised backing; wear marks: damp darkening and a musty film on the backing where moisture sat. WEAR FIRST (this is the story of the photo): damp darkening with a blurred boundary and a limp, heavier drape where it soaked in, clearly darker than the dry area, at the positions named by the topic (damp darkening and a musty film on the backing where moisture sat); it covers roughly 25-40% of that area and is strong enough to read at thumbnail size from arm's length, on the side that faces the camera; the rest of the object is clean enough that the marked area is unmistakably the problem, but the object is a used everyday item, not new stock. MATERIAL OPTICS: the fabric shows its real weave or knit texture at close range, matte with a faint sheen only along fold ridges; worn or soiled areas read as clearly darker regions that follow the contact line, with a visible edge, never as painted patches. SCENE LOCK: the same light laminate reception counter with the pink cutting mat on every slide; do not change location, backdrop, or room across slides. Create one portrait 4:5 photo. Keep the exact featured object consistent across all four photos. LOCATION: the reception counter of a small Taiwanese laundry shop: light laminate top, a pink self-healing cutting mat covering less than a fifth of the frame in one corner, white slat-wall panels behind, a receipt pad and pen pushed to the frame edge; background shelves softly out of focus; any paperwork or labels unreadable. COMPOSITION (hero, crop allowed): frame the half of the object that carries the problem, the object cut by the frame edge on one side and set off-centre with its mass near x=40% or x=60%, filling 60-75% of the frame height; one adult hand entering from the frame edge, wrist only, fingers holding or pressing right beside the problem area with five clearly separated fingers; a white plastic spray bottle with no readable label rests at the frame edge as a foreground occlusion; the surface fills the bottom of the frame, not empty space. LIGHTING: one clear key light from a window on one side: the lit side of the object is bright and the far side falls to mid-grey with a visible shadow edge running across the object; a dense contact shadow at the base that softens outward; ceiling fluorescent fills only enough to keep shadow detail; the counter or mat must not tint the whites. STYLE: candid documentary phone photo taken by the shop worker mid-inspection, the action caught while it happens, slight handheld tilt and framing imperfection; not editorial, not catalogue, not studio. CAMERA: phone main camera, 26mm-equivalent, held from the worker's standing eye line looking down about 25 degrees, f/1.8 look: the problem area sharp, the far side of the object slightly softer, the background clearly out of focus. COLOR: neutral daylight indoor tone with honest contrast, low saturation close to documentary colour, whites read white where clean and grey where soiled; no pink or warm cast on the object. Photo 1 of 4. Hero still of 地毯踩久那股味，捲起來前先看底面有沒有潮 through the passport item as the main close-up on the locked inspection counter. Keep the object recognizable even when cropped and do not imply a cleaning result. Avoid: brand logos, readable text on the object, a second object of the same kind, a waxy plastic-coated surface, a second hand.
